items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: there was a Town Hall concert we played that Randy Brecker and Dave Liebman were the horn players and Pat Martino was on guitar.

ctx.x: Very, very simple, but it sounds just exactly like the dog. And it’s in four four, which I think is not a problem, but there was a Town Hall concert we played that Randy Brecker and Dave Liebman were the horn players and Pat Martino was on guitar. And they were trying to get this tune. And it was like, no, no, you wrote it wrong, no that’s not four four.
